sky2hook (https://github.com/tge-was-taken/sky2hook), by tge-was-taken

Parts of the renderer in src/render/ follow sky2hook, each marked with a comment
naming the sky2hook source file it came from. sky2hook has no LICENSE file; its
author granted reuse in issue #2 of the Persona4-Decompilation repository,
2026-10-17
(https://github.com/Raikaru/Persona4-Decompilation/issues/2#issuecomment-6234440298):

    "In regards to licensing sky2hook, feel free to reuse parts of it."
